current_revision: architecture working tree (first complete benchmark; structural projection still rebuilds its plan)
input: generated repetitions of - Sample markdown list item for parser and upload testing. plus newline
method: Each executable starts in a new process; sizes 1 and 10 MiB; baseline then current at each size; 3 insert/undo repetitions per first/middle/last location; structural split/undo once per location. Compilers and agent CPU tests paused during measurement. Timings use steady_clock. RSS and high-water RSS are /proc/self/status VmRSS/VmHWM in KiB. Startup phases are single observations; repeated edit phases use median in results-summary.json. No CPU affinity pinning.
source_fingerprint_method: SHA256 of src/core and src/markdown .ixx/.cpp sorted by relative POSIX path components; for each: path UTF-8, NUL, file bytes, NUL.
